content.short: Metaps worked together with EMURGO on the world's first cryptocurrency card for the ADA cryptocurrency.
content.description: Metaps worked with EMURGO on an ADA cryptocurrency card designed to make Cardano more usable for everyday payments. The card initiative let users spend ADA through mobile or physical gift card formats at offline merchants in South Korea, including convenience store networks. By connecting ADA balances with merchant payment rails, Metaps helped demonstrate a practical bridge between Cardano assets and consumer spending. The project is relevant as an early Cardano payment adoption effort in Asia too.
